scientific_integrity: Exact finite-state algebra and analytic strict-concavity proof; finite checker is supplementary, not independent certification. No empirical causal claim.
scientific_limitations: Fair pairwise-independent Bernoulli shocks, iid years, complete mixing, fixed fractions, two equal high-yield habitats, one lower-yield habitat. The general Kelly and stochastic-demography literature is not exhaustively checked; Cohen 1966 full text was not inspected.
title: A sharp third-order environmental threshold for allocating offspring to a weaker habitat
